seo.title: KoalaSnap — Chat Mockup Generator & Social Post Simulator
seo.description: Generate realistic chat simulator screenshots for WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, Signal, iMessage, and social media. Free, privacy-friendly, and high-resolution PNG exports.
seo.keywords: chat mockup, whatsapp simulator, discord simulator, telegram mockup, fake chat generator, social media mockup, koalasnap
seo.headerSubtitle: Create pixel-perfect mockup screenshots for WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, Signal, iMessage, and social media posts. Perfect for presentations, tutorials, and content creation.

features.whatsapp: Design custom mobile and desktop WhatsApp chat screenshots with status indicators, bubble customization, and read receipts.
features.discord: Simulate Discord server messages, custom usernames, timestamps, and realistic colored user roles.
features.others: Generate pixel-perfect mockups for Telegram, Signal, and Apple iMessage apps with authentic UI components.
features.social: Simulate posts and comments from platforms like X (Twitter), Instagram, and TikTok with author avatar uploads.
features.export: Download Retina-quality PNG images or copy screenshots directly to your clipboard for instant sharing.
features.privacy: Completely client-side rendering. No messages, images, or assets are uploaded to any server. Your data stays in your browser.

faq.a1: KoalaSnap is a free, open-source online utility designed to generate realistic mockup screenshots of various chat and social media platforms. It runs entirely in your local browser.
faq.q2: How do I customize the chat templates?
faq.a2: Using the settings panel, you can modify contact names, statuses, battery levels, connection states (WiFi/cellular), text bubbles, send/receive status, emojis, reactions, and custom avatars.
faq.q3: Is KoalaSnap safe and private to use?
faq.a3: Yes, it is 100% private. All avatar uploads, message text changes, and image rendering are performed client-side on your own device. No data is stored, tracked, or sent to any server.
